1.o: The Thompsons open their door to an orphaned teen who says she's family, never guessing she's got ulterior motives. Now the con is on.

2.o: Molly and Jeremy attempt to cheat Nick in the "chore market." All the while, Nick's cooking up a bait and switch at Liz's restaurant.

3.o: Nick turns the school's costume dance into a scheme targeting the socially clueless. But it only fuels Jeremy's suspicions that something is up.

4.o: In a bid to gain Jeremy’s trust, Nick suggests he run for student body president - then offers her services as his campaign manager.

5.o: A paranoid Ed puts everyone on lockdown for Thompson Family Safety Day. But that doesn't work for Nick, who's got to get to an important meeting.

6.o: Jeremy leads the student council to an escape room to prove that his presidency is legit. After spying Liz's wedding ring, Nick considers stealing it.

7.o: Nick starts a GoFundMe in her biggest scam yet, only to learn she'll need Ed's help to open a bank account. Liz gives Jeremy a job at the restaurant.

8.o: When an old friend appears out of nowhere, Nick decides to skip school - and Jeremy follows them. But the plot thickens when Liz and Ed find out.

9.t: The Man in the Middle Attack
9.o: A social worker comes to the house to help Nick open up, and it works - until Molly and Jeremy find Nick's secret cell phone.

10.o: Nick makes plans to hold an estate sale while the Thompsons are away seeing "Hamilton." Little does she know, they've planned a surprise of their own.

1.o: Ed brings Nick and Molly to the bank for Take Our Daughters and Sons to Work Day, while Liz and Jeremy ask questions at the social services office.

2.o: Nick partners with a handsome new student to stack the deck at a charity poker tournament, where the Volunteer Squad questions Molly's leadership.

3.o: A '90s-themed day at school brings Liz face to face with her former rival. Nick confronts Will - then sends the Harbaughs a message.

4.o: Nick sets her sights on scamming Ed's wealthiest banking client. But an increasingly suspicious Molly is watching Nick's every move.

5.o: A flashback episode reveals the origins of Nick's revenge plot against the Thompsons - and the family's role in ruining her life.

6.o: Nick concocts a scam to teach Molly a much-needed lesson. Ed and Jeremy cook up a challenge to help Liz ace her "Top Chef" interview.

7.o: When "Top Chef" sends a camera crew to Crescendo, Nick unleashes a plan involving rats - and a Franzelli's regular - to shut it all down.

8.o: A scandal threatens Jeremy's presidency. Back at the restaurant, Liz and Molly sift through the evidence to try and figure out who set them up.

9.o: Nick moves forward with the bank heist so she can finally pay off her father's debts. Jeremy plans a special evening - and wants it to be perfect.

10.o: With nowhere to run, a cornered Nick confronts the Thompsons and comes clean. But she's got one last trick up her sleeve.

1.o: تشكّ "كيربي مازراتشي" في أن الشخص الذي اعتدى عليها منذ سنوات قد يكون مسؤولاً عن جريمة قتل وقعت مؤخراً، لكن واقعها المتغير يتحداها.

2.o: بعد ظهور دليل جديد يدعم نظرية "كيربي"، يفكر المراسل "دان فيلازكويز" في استخدامها كمصدر. "كيربي" تلقي نظرة فاحصة على الضحية.

3.o: تنظر "كيربي" و"دان" إلى الماضي، ويكشفان عن العديد من القضايا غير المحلولة التي لها أوجه تشابه محيرة. يهتم "هاربر" اهتماماً جديداً خطيراً بـ"دان".

4.o: مع تصاعد الضغط من أجل نشر المقال، يستكشف "دان" الصلات المحتملة بين ضحايا القتل. وتحاول "كيربي" فهم أحد الأدلة.

5.o: يلقى مقال "دان" رواجاً في جميع أنحاء المدينة. وبعد مواجهة مروعة، أصبح فهم "كيربي" للواقع موضع تساؤل.

6.o: "هاربر" يجد بداية جديدة عندما يعود إلى الوطن من الحرب.

7.o: يؤدي دليل جديد إلى كشف كبير في القصة. فبعدما صدمت "كيربي" "ماركوس"، ذهبت لمساعدة صديقة جديدة.

8.o: مع تحوّل واقع "كيربي"، تركّز أخيراً على تعقب "هاربر".
